address: 125 E. 39th St., New York, NY, 10016, USA
bio: Chef Hasung Lee’s first restaurant draws heavily on the fine dining experiences that shaped him. Guests begin downstairs in a wood-clad lounge inspired by Crown Daisy Farm, the Hudson Valley farm that supplies much of the restaurant’s produce, before moving upstairs for a tasting menu that blends Korean influences with contemporary fine dining. Ingredients from the farm appear throughout the meal, often alongside techniques such as fermentation and preservation. Highlights may include the signature green porridge, as well as inventive desserts like mugwort ice cream with kiwi and fava shoots. Thoughtful sourcing, ambitious cooking and a clear commitment to seasonality define the experience.
